_about: Cutouts that must not ship: an AI render with garbled or wrong lettering, a product that is not what its name says, a subject cut off at the frame, or a broken render. Found 2026-09-27 by OCR over every cutout (RapidOCR), by scripts/cutout_edges.py (a run of fully opaque pixels along an edge is a crop, a real edge is anti-aliased; confirmed by eye), and by eye over every cutout a live template uses. scripts/audit_templates.mjs and audit_showcase_content.mjs hold back any card that draws one (defect 'asset'); offer-library.js never uses them.
